method: Spin-offs that the price vendor recorded as a distribution in Adjusted Close instead of a split-like ratio. The vendor's Close stays unchanged, so the share basis of the price is right; only the Spin-off marker needs the event. The separated part of the price is 1 - (Adjusted Close / Close before) / (Adjusted Close / Close on the event day), from the vendor's own series. Found by a scan of every session for a change of that ratio above 3% (Fable 5.2 review, M50); the other changes above 3% are cash dividends.

evidence.statement: Adient completed its separation from Johnson Controls International and began trading on the NYSE on 31 Oct 2016.
One Adient share for every 10 JCI shares; first regular-way close 45.51, so 4.551 per JCI share against the vendor's 4.70 (price-audit-reviews.json).

distributions.note: JCI's FY2016 report (period ending 30 Sep 2016) still includes Adient, about 16.8 billion of 37.7 billion revenue, while prices from 31 Oct 2016 exclude it.
